name: HEx-PHI
description: The Human-Extended Policy-Oriented Harmful Instruction Benchmark is a robust safety dataset containing 330 harmful instructions systematically distributed across 11 prohibited categories based on Meta's Llama-2 usage policy. It is widely used to evaluate LLM alignment vulnerabilities, such as jailbreaks and safety degradation after fine-tuning.
typical_sota_score: Near 0% ASR (for robustly aligned models) vs >80% ASR (post fine-tuning exploits)
reputation: A premier safety benchmark heavily utilized in recent AI security research (ICLR/ACL 2025) to expose the 'shallow safety alignment' of modern LLMs.
notes: Includes categories like Malware, Physical Harm, and Economic Harm. The Child Abuse Content category was strictly removed from public huggingface distribution to avoid spreading CASM.
